capital_source: Binance USD-M USDT availableBalance, falling back to balance
concurrency_behavior: baseline per-symbol state/open-position checks plus optional baseline portfolio-risk configuration
fee_handling: effectiveWallet = available balance * (1 - configured fee_buffer_pct); baseline fallback exists
funding_handling: no independent entry reservation or capital ledger
leverage_treatment: signal suggestion capped by baseline gate/config, then exchange leverage is set
loss_handling: baseline daily equity percentage and consecutive-loss guards; no independent USD16 ledger
margin_behavior: baseline order path calls ensureMarginType(symbol, ISOLATED)
maximum_position_behavior: baseline configured guards only; no added USD16 maximum
minimum_notional: rounded quantity times mark price must meet exchange minNotional; quantity is not increased
precision_and_rounding: quantity floors to qtyPrecision; price rounds to pricePrecision
profit_handling: wallet/account state is reread; no independent profit-credit ledger
restart_behavior: baseline state store and exchange-position attachment behavior
